commonMistakes.tr: Binding'de yanlis port/host header, durmus app pool, sertifikanin yanlis store'da olmasi ve NTFS izin eksikligi sik gorulur.
commonMistakes.en: Wrong port/host header in bindings, stopped app pool, certificate in wrong store, and missing NTFS permissions are common.

verificationChecks.tr: Site bindings, app pool state, Event Viewer, IIS logs, certificate binding ve klasor izinlerini kontrol et.
verificationChecks.en: Check site bindings, app pool state, Event Viewer, IIS logs, certificate binding, and folder permissions.

expertTips.tr: Application pool identity izin problemi binding duzeltildikten sonra bile 401/503 uretebilir.
expertTips.en: Application pool identity permission issues can still cause 401/503 even after fixing bindings.
